{{Character|name=Male Sage|image=File: 二阶-男贤者.png}}{{Character|name=Female Sage|image=File: 二阶-女贤者.png}}

== OVERVIEW ==
A strategist who masters the battlefield through specialized abilities and techniques, excelling at shifting the scales of victory with ingenious buff and debuff spells.

The '''Sage''' acts as the battlefield commander, capable of both cloaking teammates in the radiant blessings of holy prayers and binding enemies with the debilitating shackles of cunning hexes.

They can also command mystical totem creatures to fight alongside them, becoming a one-person army.

A true versatile master of the battlefield and a summoner of totems, they use light to heal their allies and darkness to punish the enemy forces.
